about: On the character itself: whether a creation session stands on it. HasDummy is true while a session with a dummy is open for the character, Canceled marks a cancelled one. Script Extender: CCState.

evidence.says: Script Extender declares eoc::character_creation::StateComponent::HasDummy at +0x0 (BG3Extender/GameDefinitions/Components/CharacterCreation.h:176): its author's name and type; the offset is computed from the declared types. Not checked against the game's code.

Script Extender declares eoc::character_creation::StateComponent::Canceled at +0x1 (BG3Extender/GameDefinitions/Components/CharacterCreation.h:176): its author's name and type; the offset is computed from the declared types. Not checked against the game's code.

Script Extender declares eoc::character_creation::StateComponent::field_2 at +0x2 (BG3Extender/GameDefinitions/Components/CharacterCreation.h:176): its author's name and type; the offset is computed from the declared types; the computed offset equals the one in its earlier name. Not checked against the game's code.
the game's executable keeps this type name among its ECS type names (gatekit symbols types)

on the host of Basic_Level_A HasDummy reads false; after Osi.StartChangeAppearance it reads true and stays true after the widget CharacterChangeAppearance is closed without the session being ended; Canceled false and the third byte 0 throughout

questions.ask: what clears HasDummy: end a session by the window's own confirm and by its cancel and read the three bytes after each

survey.names: Every name here is Script Extender's author's (his headers), not the game's own: they are kept because they are what the extender's Lua answers to and what bg3_verify compares, and every field carries the rung `extender` - the extender's name for the field at that offset, which nobody has checked against the game's code. A name is raised from `extender` only with evidence from the code, by `gatekit names set`.
